# Daniel Mwihoti

> Daniel Edward Mwihoti is a global Bitcoin, Cardano, AI and Rust developer based in Nairobi, Kenya, working with remote teams worldwide. Full-stack engineer with merged pull requests in five major open-source organizations (Payjoin/rust-payjoin, IntersectMBO, Cardano Foundation, rust-bitcoin, Stacks explorer). Available for freelance contracts, remote roles, and open-source collaboration.

Key facts:
- Role: Software Developer — Full-Stack, Blockchain (Bitcoin & Cardano), AI/CV, Rust
- Experience: 3+ years, 20+ products shipped (6+ live), merged PRs in 5 open-source orgs

## Selected projects

- [StackMate](https://stack-mate.vercel.app): Builder-partner marketplace on Bitcoin L2 (Stacks); four Clarity smart contracts on mainnet anchor a verifiable builder reputation trail
- [OmniCaption AI](https://omnicaptionai.fly.dev): Multi-agent video-intelligence platform — 13 specialised AI agents produce transcripts, accessibility descriptions, emotion timelines, and social captions with a hallucination-verification loop; deployed on AMD ROCm (AMD Developer Hackathon)
- [BobOpenSource](https://bobopensource-live.vercel.app): AI developer tool that analyzes a GitHub repo + issue, maps dependencies, and generates an implementation roadmap with risk notes, plus interactive "Ask Bob" Q&A
- [Personal AI Agent — Bitcoin OSS Triage Bot](https://danpersonalagent.vercel.app): Autonomous agent scanning GitHub daily for high-signal contribution opportunities, LLM-analyzed, delivered as a prioritized Telegram digest (@btc_opensource_projects_bot)
- [Open Wallet Standard](https://open-wallet-standard.onrender.com): Multi-chain AI-agent wallet across 9 networks with policy-gated signing — agents never hold raw keys
- [Bitcoin Wallet Lab](https://wallet-lab.onrender.com): Educational testnet4 wallet; secp256k1 + ECDSA + RFC 6979 implemented from scratch in Rust
- [Certified Chain](https://certified-chain.vercel.app): Credential issuance on Cardano — certificate NFTs (Mesh SDK/Blockfrost), Aiken on-chain revocation, zero-knowledge privacy layer (Midnight Network), IPFS/Pinata
- [Memorabilia](https://memorabilia-game.vercel.app): Fully on-chain Starknet memory game, gasless via Account Abstraction, playable as a Telegram Mini App
- [Daily Habit Hub](https://daily-habit-hub.vercel.app): Fitness tracking with Web3 rewards on Avalanche
- [Computer Vision](https://github.com/mwihoti/computer_vision): Dual Python + Rust YOLO/ONNX system for edge deployment on NVIDIA Jetson

## Open source

- IntersectMBO/lsm-tree — PR #818 merged: Haskell record-extension refactor in a production LSM database used by the Cardano node
- Cardano Foundation/cardano-org — Kenya ADA on-ramp listings; Docker containerisation for the docs platform
